title: Ty's Bad GUI
description: A GUI that displays useful in-game statistics such as FPS (frames per second), player coordinates (position), facing direction (orientation), and ping (network latency), all in an organized and minimal layout.
body: A GUI that displays useful in-game statistics such as FPS (frames per second), player coordinates (position), facing direction (orientation), and ping (network latency), all in an organized and minimal layout, with a clean presentation that makes the information easy to read at a glance.
